svg.title: Line of sight — 016 / The unreachable field — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Line of sight: 016 / The unreachable field, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Fog has a soft irregular edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Propositions and observations are pictograms beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: NO ONE IN THIS STORY CAN SEE THIS PAGE. THIS MAP DOES NOT UPDATE.
016.2–5 / OAI-BH, one conference talk; no independent review · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC TERRAIN / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
